intro:
**The best early SIM-only Black Friday deal we can confirm is Lebara's 50GB plan at £2.38 a month for four months, then £7.95, on a one-month rolling contract with no annual price rise.** If you want a big data allowance, iD Mobile's 200GB plan at £7 a month for three months, then £14, is the stronger pick.

Early Black Friday SIM deals have been live since Monday 2 November, and most should run until Cyber Monday on 30 November. Rolling and 12-month SIM-only plans rarely get much cheaper on the day itself, so if one below suits you there's little reason to wait. Prices were checked on Uswitch's Black Friday listings, updated 6 November 2026.

body:
## What's actually on offer this Black Friday

SIM-only deals don't work like TV or air fryer deals. There's no big one-day price crash. Instead, networks run cheap introductory prices for a few months, add extra data, or knock a few pounds off a 12-month plan. Comparison sites such as Uswitch started flagging early Black Friday SIM deals on 2 November, and most of these offers should stay live until Cyber Monday on 30 November. A few networks may still add one-off "hero" deals over the Black Friday weekend itself, often for only a couple of days.

So the sensible approach is to pick the right type of plan now and grab a good price when you see one, rather than holding out for 27 November.

## How to choose a SIM-only deal

**1. Work out how much data you really use.** Check your phone's settings for the last few months. Most people use under 20GB a month. If you're on Wi-Fi at home and work, 5GB to 30GB is plenty. If you stream on the train or use your phone as a hotspot, look at 100GB or more.

**2. Compare the cost over 12 months, not the headline price.** An offer of £2.38 a month sounds incredible, but it only lasts four months. We've worked out the first-year cost for each deal above, so you can compare like for like.

**3. Check for annual price rises.** Since January 2025, Ofcom has required networks to show any mid-contract rise in pounds and pence. Some, like O2, add a fixed amount each April. Others, including iD Mobile and Lebara on the deals above, promise no rise at all. Add the rise into your sums.

**4. Rolling or 12 months?** A one-month rolling plan lets you leave any time, which is handy if prices drop again. A 12-month plan usually gives more data for the money but locks you in. Avoid 24-month SIM-only plans unless the saving is large, because better deals tend to appear long before two years are up.

**5. Network coverage.** Cheaper brands piggyback on the big four: Lebara uses Vodafone, iD Mobile and SMARTY use Three, giffgaff and Tesco Mobile use O2, and VOXI uses Vodafone. Check each network's coverage checker for your postcode before you switch.

## Target prices for Black Friday 2026

Based on this month's listings, these are good prices to aim for:

- **5GB or less:** under £5 a month, with no annual rise.
- **30GB to 60GB:** £6 to £8 a month.
- **100GB to 200GB:** under £12 a month averaged over the year.
- **Unlimited data:** under £15 a month is a good price. Watch for a short-lived unlimited deal from one of the smaller networks over the Black Friday weekend.

If a "Black Friday" deal is above these, it's probably just the normal price with a new label.

## How to switch and keep your number

Switching is free and quick. Text **PAC** to **65075** from your current phone and you'll get a code by text, along with any early-exit fees you'd owe. Give the code to your new network when you order, and your number moves across within one working day. If you want a new number instead, text **STAC** to **75075**.

Before you switch, check your phone isn't locked to your old network (most are unlocked now) and that it supports eSIM if you want to skip waiting for a SIM card in the post.

## Frequently asked questions

### Are SIM-only deals cheaper on Black Friday?

A little. Most networks run introductory discounts or extra data from early November until Cyber Monday. The savings are usually a few pounds a month rather than a big one-off cut, so a good early deal is rarely beaten by much on the day.

### When do SIM-only Black Friday deals start?

Early Black Friday SIM deals have been listed since Monday 2 November 2026. Black Friday itself is on 27 November and Cyber Monday is on 30 November, and most deals should last until then.

### Will I need a credit check for a SIM-only deal?

It depends on the network and contract. One-month rolling plans, like the Lebara deals above, usually don't need one. Most 12-month contracts do, but SIM-only plans with no handset are generally easier to get than phone contracts.

### Is a rolling SIM better than a 12-month contract?

Rolling plans give you freedom to leave each month, which suits anyone who likes to switch to the next good deal. A 12-month plan often gives more data for the price and may come with perks, but you're tied in. If the 12-month cost is similar, take the rolling plan.

### Can I keep my phone number when I switch?

Yes. Text PAC to 65075 to get your switching code, give it to your new network, and your number moves over within one working day. It's free.
